description.zh: 允许的语音编码,支持格式: 1. g729 2. g729,alaw,ulaw 3. alaw,ulaw,g729 4. alaw,ulaw 5. myopus,alaw,ulaw5. myopus,alaw,ulaw6. myopus,g729,alaw,ulaw 7. myopus,g729 公网+远程话机支持配置1/2/3;专线+远程话机支持配置1/2;公网+软电话支持配置4;专线+软电话支持配置5;
description.en:
Specifies the codec configuration by its ID.
Valid values:
`1`: `g729`
`2`: `g729, alaw, ulaw`
`3`: `alaw, ulaw, g729`
`4`: `alaw, ulaw`
`5`: `myopus, alaw, ulaw`
`6`: `myopus, g729, alaw, ulaw`
`7`: `myopus, g729`
The supported configuration depends on the endpoint and network:
- **Remote phone + public network**: `1`, `2`, or `3`
- **Remote phone + leased line**: `1` or `2`
- **Softphone + public network**: `4`
- **Softphone + leased line**: `5`
Specifies the area code for the extension.

description.zh: 呼叫权限；0：无限制，1：国内长途，2：国内本市，3：内部呼叫，默认无限制
description.en: Specifies the calling permission. Valid values: `0` (Unlimited), `1` (National long-distance), `2` (Local), and `3` (Internal calls only). The default value is `0`.

description.zh: 降噪开关；0:关闭 1:开启 (该参数只有在类型为注册到webrtc才有效)
description.en: Specifies whether to enable noise reduction. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled). This parameter applies only when `Type` is set to `2`.
The extension number. Must be 3 to 11 digits.

description.zh: iad网关；该参数只有在类型为，注册到IAD分机，才有效
description.en: Specifies the name of the IAD gateway. This parameter applies only when `Type` is set to `1`.

description.zh: 呼入是否录音；0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
description.en: Specifies whether to record inbound calls. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled). The default value is `1`.

description.zh: 是否允许摘机外呼，0：不允许，1：允许，默认允许
description.en: Specifies whether to allow off-hook dialing. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled). The default value is `1`.

description.zh: 是否允许外呼；0：不允许，1：允许，默认允许
description.en: Specifies whether to allow outbound calls. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled). The default value is `1`.

description.zh: 网络防抖；0：关闭，1：开启，默认关闭
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the jitter buffer. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled). The default value is `0`.

description.zh: 外呼是否录音；0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
description.en: Specifies whether to record outbound calls. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled). The default value is `1`.
Specifies custom properties for the extension in a JSON-formatted string.

description.zh: 类型；1. 注册到IAD分机 2.注册到webrtc 3.注册到远程话机
description.en: Specifies the registration type for the extension. Valid values: `1` (IAD gateway), `2` (softphone), and `3` (remote phone).
